queries.currentMammalSpecies: WITH RECURSIVE mammal_descendants(tsn) AS (SELECT ?1 UNION ALL SELECT u.tsn FROM taxonomic_units u JOIN mammal_descendants d ON u.parent_tsn = d.tsn WHERE u.name_usage = 'valid') SELECT u.tsn, l.completename AS scientific_name, u.name_usage, u.credibility_rtng, u.completeness_rtng, u.currency_rating, u.update_date FROM mammal_descendants d JOIN taxonomic_units u ON u.tsn = d.tsn JOIN taxon_unit_types r ON r.kingdom_id = u.kingdom_id AND r.rank_id = u.rank_id JOIN longnames l ON l.tsn = u.tsn WHERE lower(trim(r.rank_name)) = 'species' AND u.name_usage = 'valid' ORDER BY u.tsn
queries.mammalSpeciesSynonyms: WITH RECURSIVE mammal_descendants(tsn) AS (SELECT ?1 UNION ALL SELECT u.tsn FROM taxonomic_units u JOIN mammal_descendants d ON u.parent_tsn = d.tsn WHERE u.name_usage = 'valid'), accepted_mammal_species(tsn) AS (SELECT u.tsn FROM mammal_descendants d JOIN taxonomic_units u ON u.tsn = d.tsn JOIN taxon_unit_types r ON r.kingdom_id = u.kingdom_id AND r.rank_id = u.rank_id WHERE lower(trim(r.rank_name)) = 'species' AND u.name_usage = 'valid') SELECT s.tsn AS synonym_tsn, sl.completename AS synonym_name, su.name_usage AS synonym_usage, su.unaccept_reason, su.update_date AS synonym_update_date, s.tsn_accepted FROM synonym_links s JOIN accepted_mammal_species a ON a.tsn = s.tsn_accepted JOIN taxonomic_units su ON su.tsn = s.tsn JOIN taxon_unit_types sr ON sr.kingdom_id = su.kingdom_id AND sr.rank_id = su.rank_id JOIN longnames sl ON sl.tsn = su.tsn WHERE lower(trim(sr.rank_name)) = 'species' ORDER BY s.tsn, s.tsn_accepted

colInput.ownershipProjectionCompatibility: The current ownership projection differs from the pinned import input only in datasetPackageVersion, package-definitions SHA-256 and generatedBy script SHA-256. Routes, accepted-species membership, package counts and coverage proof are unchanged; all six checked sidecar files remain byte-identical.

normalization: Remove the exact trailing COL authorship field from COL scientificName when that suffix is present; no authorship parser is used.
Normalize Unicode to NFC, replace underscores with spaces, collapse Unicode whitespace and trim.
For species-rank comparison, remove one parenthesized subgenus token in the exact Genus (Subgenus) species representation; genus and specific epithet must remain unchanged.
Preserve case, diacritics, punctuation and all remaining name tokens.

matching.accepted: The normalized COL name resolves to exactly one valid ITIS Mammalia species and directly equals that current ITIS name.
matching.synonym-current-name-redirect: The normalized COL name equals one or more official ITIS invalid species names whose synonym_links rows resolve to exactly one valid ITIS Mammalia species.
matching.ambiguous: The normalized exact evidence resolves to more than one valid ITIS Mammalia species TSN.
matching.unmatched: No normalized exact valid-name or official species-synonym evidence resolves to a valid ITIS Mammalia species.
matching.forbidden: No fuzzy, edit-distance, phonetic, case-folded, diacritic-stripped, token-reordered, genus-substitution or higher-rank match is permitted.

generatedBy.deterministic: Pinned input checksums, exact SQL, fixed route priority, exact name normalization and explicit sorting; no wall-clock values or fuzzy matching.
